WITH account_sums AS (
  SELECT 
    t.account_id,
    d.A3 as region,
    SUM(t.amount) as account_sum,
    COUNT(*) as transaction_count
  FROM trans t
  INNER JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3
),
region_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    SUM(account_sum) as region_total
  FROM account_sums
  GROUP BY region
)
SELECT 
  a.account_id,
  a.region,
  a.account_sum,
  a.transaction_count,
  CASE WHEN rt.region_total != 0 THEN CAST(a.account_sum AS REAL) / rt.region_total END as share
FROM account_sums a
JOIN region_totals rt ON a.region = rt.region
ORDER BY CASE WHEN share IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, share DESC
LIMIT 10
